workspaceSub: Launch and prepare the tools installed on this computer.
discoverSub: Choose a tool for your work. Review access terms and compatibility before installing.
searchHint: Search by tool or service name and purpose.
launchNote: This is the launch request status. Model connectivity and in-tool behavior need separate checks.
stateUnknown: Launch state could not be checked. Check again.
alreadyRunning: The app is running. Close it before changing launch mode.
rtlMissing: The RTL adapter is unavailable. Check your VibeHub installation or explicitly choose normal launch.
noInstalledSub: Explore tools, or check this computer again after installing one.
partial: Some information could not be read. Successfully detected tools are still shown.
operationFailed: This action could not be completed
recovery: Try again. If the problem continues, open Diagnostics.
installNote: Installation happens through the official publisher. Return here after installing and check again.
modelManual: Save and test a connection in Models, then follow this tool’s guide. Keys are not automatically sent to other tools.
noCompatibility: No verified compatibility is recorded. Check the tool’s official guide.
trySearch: Try a shorter query or a different name.
editorUnknown: In-editor behavior and proxy routing have not been tested.
vaultFailure: The credential vault could not complete this action
proxyFailure: The proxy profile or route could not be used
networkFailure: The service could not be reached
nativeFailure: The desktop service could not be reached
